# Python packages the Windows ctest lanes import (the Ubuntu lanes get the same
# module from apt:python3-yaml). Installed with pip --require-hashes
# --only-binary=:all:, so only these exact wheels can land; add the wheel hash
# for a new runner Python before the image moves to it. Declared as pip:PyYAML
# in ThirdParty/supply-chain.lock; tools/check-supply-chain.py rejects any line
# here that is not an exact name==version pin with sha256 hashes.
#
# PyYAML 6.0.3 win_amd64 wheels for CPython 3.12, 3.13 and 3.14 (PyPI digests).
